Operations for a specific object kind (use object <kind> …)

Subcommands: fields, list, get, create, update, delete.
Help lists registered schemas (object_specs). list/count show CAS/stream instances — often empty when only the schema exists (e.g. team_configuration, object_spec under _internal).

Usage:
  zqk object <kind> [flags]
  zqk object <kind> [command]

Available Commands:
  create      Create a new object
  delete      Delete one or more objects by ID
  fields      List available fields for this object kind
  get         Get an object by ID
  list        List objects of a specific kind
  update      Update an existing object

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)

Use "zqk object <kind> [command] --help" for more information about a command.
